summary_zh: 本章讲 OSPF 路由器之间是怎么从互不相识变成邻居、再变成完全邻接的。先讲 hello 报文如何发现邻居以及必须匹配哪些参数,再讲邻居状态从 Down 到 Full 的推进过程,然后讲广播网络上 DR 与 BDR 的选举规则,最后用 show ip ospf neighbor 命令验证结果。
scope_zh: 本章覆盖 hello 报文与邻居发现、邻居状态迁移、DR/BDR 选举、邻居验证命令;不涉及原文之外的其他内容。

sections.intro_zh: OSPF 要先找到邻居,才能谈后面的一切。

points.text_zh: OSPF 路由器靠 hello 报文在链路上发现邻居。
points.text_en_quote: OSPF routers use hello packets to discover neighbors on a link.

points.text_zh: 在广播网段上,hello 报文发往组播地址 224.0.0.5,每 10 秒发一次。
points.text_en_quote: The hello packet is sent to multicast address 224.0.0.5 every 10 seconds on a broadcast network segment.

points.text_zh: 只有当 hello interval、dead interval、area ID 和子网掩码全部一致时,两台路由器才会成为邻居。
points.text_en_quote: Two routers become neighbors only when the hello interval, the dead interval, the area ID and the subnet mask all match.

points.text_zh: dead interval 默认是 40 秒,正好是 hello interval 的四倍。
points.text_en_quote: The dead interval is 40 seconds by default, which is four times the hello interval.

figures.explain_zh: 图中三台路由器 R1、R2、R3 依次相连,R1 与 R2 之间是 192.168.12.0/24,R2 与 R3 之间是 192.168.23.0/24。每条链路上的两台路由器互发 hello 报文来发现对方。
callouts_zh: 两台路由器要在同一条链路上,hello 报文才能互相收到

visuals.title_zh: hello 报文如何建立邻居关系
visuals.why_zh: 原文只用一句话说明 hello 报文发现邻居,但没有展示报文在链路上来回的过程,初学者不容易想象
visuals.caption_zh: 只有四项参数全部匹配,双方才会承认对方是邻居。
grounding: OSPF routers use hello packets to discover neighbors on a link.
Two routers become neighbors only when the hello interval, the dead interval, the area ID and the subnet mask all match.

steps.title_zh: R1 发出 hello 报文
steps.note_zh: hello 报文发往组播地址 224.0.0.5。

steps.title_zh: R2 回送 hello 报文
steps.note_zh: 双方都要收到对方的 hello 报文。
hello interval、dead interval、area ID、subnet mask 必须全部一致。

points.text_zh: 在邻接关系建立完成之前,OSPF 邻居会经历若干个状态。
points.text_en_quote: An OSPF neighbor moves through several states before the adjacency is complete.

points.text_zh: 最初的状态是 Down,表示还没有收到过任何 hello 报文。
points.text_en_quote: The first state is Down, where no hello packet has been received yet.

points.text_zh: 路由器一旦收到 hello 报文,就把该邻居置为 Init 状态。
points.text_en_quote: When a router receives a hello packet it moves the neighbor to the Init state.

points.text_zh: 当路由器在收到的 hello 报文里看到自己的 router ID 时,邻居进入 2-Way 状态。
points.text_en_quote: Once the router sees its own router ID in the received hello packet, the neighbor moves to the 2-Way state.

points.text_zh: 数据库交换完成之后,邻居到达 Full 状态。
points.text_en_quote: After the database exchange finishes, the neighbor reaches the Full state.

visuals.why_zh: 原文用四句话描述状态推进,文字形式看不出状态之间的先后与触发条件
visuals.caption_zh: 每个箭头上的文字就是原文给出的触发条件。
grounding: The first state is Down, where no hello packet has been received yet.
When a router receives a hello packet it moves the neighbor to the Init state.
Once the router sees its own router ID in the received hello packet, the neighbor moves to the 2-Way state.
After the database exchange finishes, the neighbor reaches the Full state.

spec.code:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Down
    Down --> Init: receives a hello packet
    Init --> TwoWay: sees its own router ID
    TwoWay --> Full: database exchange finishes

sections.heading_zh: DR 与 BDR 的选举

points.text_zh: 在广播网络上,OSPF 会选出一台 DR 和一台 BDR。
points.text_en_quote: On a broadcast network OSPF elects a designated router and a backup designated router.

points.text_zh: OSPF priority 最高的路由器成为 DR。
points.text_en_quote: The router with the highest OSPF priority becomes the designated router.

points.text_zh: priority 相同时,router ID 最大的路由器赢得选举。
points.text_en_quote: When the priority is equal, the router with the highest router ID wins the election.

points.text_zh: priority 为 0 的路由器永远不会成为 DR。
points.text_en_quote: A priority of 0 means the router will never become the designated router.

points.text_zh: 其余路由器只与 DR 和 BDR 建立完全邻接关系。
points.text_en_quote: All other routers form a full adjacency only with the DR and the BDR.

figures.explain_zh: 图中 R1、R2、R3 处在同一个广播网络上,选举产生 DR 和 BDR 之后,其余路由器只与这两台建立完全邻接关系。

visuals.why_zh: 原文把选举规则拆在三句话里,容易记混谁先谁后
grounding: The router with the highest OSPF priority becomes the designated router.
When the priority is equal, the router with the highest router ID wins the election.
A priority of 0 means the router will never become the designated router.

rows: router ID 最大者赢得选举

points.text_zh: 用 show ip ospf neighbor 命令来验证邻接关系。
points.text_en_quote: Use the show ip ospf neighbor command to verify the adjacency.

points.text_zh: 命令输出会显示邻居状态和对应的接口。
points.text_en_quote: The output below shows the neighbor state and the interface.

configs.code:
R1#show ip ospf neighbor
Neighbor ID     Pri   State           Dead Time   Address         Interface
2.2.2.2           1   FULL/DR         00:00:34    192.168.12.2    GigabitEthernet0/1
configs.explain_zh: 这段输出对应原文的验证步骤:邻居状态和接口都能在这里看到。

annotations_zh.note_zh: Neighbor ID 为 2.2.2.2,Pri 为 1,State 为 FULL/DR,接口是 GigabitEthernet0/1。

key_takeaways_zh: hello 报文负责发现邻居,在广播网段上发往 224.0.0.5,每 10 秒一次。
hello interval、dead interval、area ID、subnet mask 四项必须全部匹配才能成为邻居。
DR 选举先比 OSPF priority,再比 router ID;priority 为 0 的永不当选。
show ip ospf neighbor 用来验证邻居状态和接口。

feynman.explain_back_zh: 两台 OSPF 路由器要合作,得先互相打招呼。它们在链路上不断发 hello 报文,广播网段上这个报文发到 224.0.0.5,每 10 秒一次。收到之后还要核对四样东西:hello interval、dead interval、area ID 和子网掩码,四样全对上才算邻居。接着关系一步步升级:一开始是 Down,收到 hello 变 Init,在对方的 hello 里看见自己的 router ID 就变 2-Way,数据库交换完成就到 Full。如果这是个广播网络,大家还要先选出 DR 和 BDR,其余路由器只跟这两位建立完全邻接。最后用 show ip ospf neighbor 看一眼状态就知道成没成。

questions.q_zh: OSPF 路由器用什么来发现链路上的邻居?
questions.q_en: What do OSPF routers use to discover neighbors on a link?
questions.answer_en: They use hello packets to discover neighbors on a link.
questions.evidence_quote: OSPF routers use hello packets to discover neighbors on a link.

questions.q_zh: 在广播网段上,hello 报文发往哪个组播地址?发送间隔是多少?
questions.q_en: On a broadcast network segment, to which multicast address is the hello packet sent, and how often?
questions.answer_en: It is sent to multicast address 224.0.0.5 every 10 seconds.
questions.evidence_quote: The hello packet is sent to multicast address 224.0.0.5 every 10 seconds on a broadcast network segment.

questions.q_zh: 两台路由器要成为邻居,必须匹配哪四项参数?
questions.q_en: Which four parameters must match before two routers become neighbors?
questions.answer_zh: hello interval、dead interval、area ID 和子网掩码,四项都要一致。
questions.answer_en: The hello interval, the dead interval, the area ID and the subnet mask must all match.
questions.evidence_quote: Two routers become neighbors only when the hello interval, the dead interval, the area ID and the subnet mask all match.

questions.q_zh: dead interval 默认是多少秒?它和 hello interval 是什么关系?
questions.q_en: What is the default dead interval, and how does it relate to the hello interval?
questions.answer_zh: 默认 40 秒,是 hello interval 的四倍。
questions.answer_en: The dead interval is 40 seconds by default, which is four times the hello interval.
questions.evidence_quote: The dead interval is 40 seconds by default, which is four times the hello interval.

questions.q_zh: 邻居状态从最初到完成一共经过哪几个状态?触发条件分别是什么?
questions.q_en: Which neighbor states does an OSPF neighbor go through, and what triggers each transition?
questions.answer_zh: 先是 Down,表示还没收到 hello 报文;收到 hello 报文后进入 Init;在收到的 hello 报文里看到自己的 router ID 后进入 2-Way;数据库交换完成后到达 Full。
questions.answer_en: The first state is Down, where no hello packet has been received yet. When a router receives a hello packet it moves the neighbor to the Init state. Once the router sees its own router ID in the received hello packet, the neighbor moves to the 2-Way state. After the database exchange finishes, the neighbor reaches the Full state.
questions.evidence_quote: An OSPF neighbor moves through several states before the adjacency is complete.

questions.q_zh: 广播网络上 DR 是怎么选出来的?
questions.q_en: How is the designated router elected on a broadcast network?
questions.answer_zh: 先比 OSPF priority,最高的成为 DR;priority 相同时比 router ID,最大的赢得选举。
questions.answer_en: The router with the highest OSPF priority becomes the designated router. When the priority is equal, the router with the highest router ID wins the election.
questions.evidence_quote: The router with the highest OSPF priority becomes the designated router.
scoring_points_zh: 先 priority 后 router ID

questions.q_zh: priority 设为 0 的路由器会怎样?其余路由器又和谁建立完全邻接关系?
questions.q_en: What happens to a router with a priority of 0, and with which routers do the other routers form a full adjacency?
questions.answer_zh: priority 为 0 的路由器永远不会成为 DR;其余路由器只与 DR 和 BDR 建立完全邻接关系。
questions.answer_en: A priority of 0 means the router will never become the designated router, and all other routers form a full adjacency only with the DR and the BDR.
questions.evidence_quote: A priority of 0 means the router will never become the designated router.
scoring_points_zh: 只与 DR 和 BDR 完全邻接

questions.q_zh: 用哪条命令验证邻接关系?输出里能看到什么?
questions.q_en: Which command verifies the adjacency, and what does its output show?
questions.answer_zh: 用 show ip ospf neighbor;输出会显示邻居状态和接口。
questions.answer_en: Use the show ip ospf neighbor command; the output shows the neighbor state and the interface.
questions.evidence_quote: Use the show ip ospf neighbor command to verify the adjacency.

blind_spots_zh: 容易只记住 hello interval 要一致,忘了 dead interval、area ID 和子网掩码也必须一致。
容易把 2-Way 的触发条件记成收到 hello 报文,实际上是在对方的 hello 报文里看到了自己的 router ID。
容易忘记 priority 为 0 的路由器永远不会成为 DR。
review_plan_zh: 第 1 天:合上笔记复述邻居状态的四个阶段与触发条件。
第 3 天:只看拓扑图,讲一遍 DR 选举的判定顺序。
